jobs.description:

jobs.description:
As an Inside Sales Representative, you are responsible for providing excellent service and commercial support to customers in a specific region: Middle East, Africa and Eastern Europe. You work hand in hand with the External Sales Representative and help strengthen customer relationships, drive sales growth, and promote the use of our digital tools. 
Key responsibilities:
 
 

• Open new customer accounts (approx. 30%) and grow business with existing customers (approx. 70%) 

• Prepare accurate offers and price calculations 

• Enter and follow up on orders 

• Actively manage your accounts via phone and email, with a focus on cross-selling and digital migration 

• Maintain and update customer data in the internal system 

• Understand customer needs, market context, product applications, and competitors 

• Be the main point of contact for customer inquiries, complaints, and support 

• Identify and close commercial opportunities 

• Report on sales projects and progress in close collaboration with External Sales 

• Contribute to the team with flexibility and a hands-on attitude 
 

• You have a technical and/or commercial background 

• You have at least 4 years of B2B sales experience, preferably with technical products 

• You are fluent in English (spoken and written) – mandatory 

• Polish, Czech or another Eastern European language is a strong asset 

• French and/or Arabic is an asset 

• Strong skills in Excel and general IT tools 

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 

• You are proactive, persuasive, structured, and a true team player 

• Able to multitask and work under pressure in a small but ambitious team

Responsibilities

• Evaluate backend and endpoint infrastructure to define upgrades, changes, and expansion proposals.
• Conduct feasibility studies and evaluate hardware and software solutions to meet organizational needs.
• Develop technical designs in alignment with specific architectural requirements and implement system improvements.
• Provide high-level support and maintenance for the IT infrastructure following ITIL methodologies.
• Deliver technical advice and information to internal and external stakeholders regarding the technology stack.
• Maintain technical documentation and actively share expertise within the engineering team.

Requirements

• You possess 8+ years of experience in system engineering within large-scale environments of at least 100,000 endpoints.
• You have expert knowledge of Intune, including MDM, MAM, BYOD, Enterprise Mobility + Security, and Conditional Access Policies.
• You bring advanced expertise in System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM), focusing on distribution groups, task sequences, and software management.
• You have in-depth experience with Active Directory, LDAP, GPO, and domain management.
• You possess deep expertise in infrastructure stacks for Windows, MacOS, Linux, Android, and iOS.
• You have 5+ years of experience with PowerShell and VBScript for infrastructure automation.
• You bring broad knowledge of Azure, including license assignment and dynamic groups, alongside Office 365 and Windows Defender.
• You possess a solid understanding of networking protocols such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and VLAN.
• You’re able to interact effectively with diverse technical and business stakeholders.
• You are fluent in Dutch or French with a very good level of English.
Nice to Haves

• Certifications in MCSA, MCSE, or MCSD.
• Experience with ServiceNow or PM² methodology.
• Knowledge of PatchMyPC or 3rd party MDM solutions like Knox or KAI.

jobs.occupation: AI Security Engineer – LLM & GenAI Security
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Perform threat modeling, risk assessments, and security evaluations for GenAI, ML, and agentic AI solutions.
• Develop security guardrails for identity management, least privilege, data protection, and prompt security.
• Test for abuse scenarios such as prompt injection, data exfiltration, and unauthorized tool usage.
• Integrate security requirements into sandboxes, gateways, CI/CD pipelines, and production platforms.
• Design security monitoring and incident response protocols specifically for AI components.
• Evaluate the supply chain risk of vendors, models, libraries, and external AI services.

Requirements

• You have 3+ years of experience in security engineering covering cybersecurity, cloud security, IAM, or DevSecOps.
• You possess 3+ years of experience integrating security controls within software development pipelines and cloud platforms.
• You bring 1+ years of experience identifying security risks associated with LLMs, agents, and model supply chains.
• You have 1+ years of experience conducting technical security testing and risk assessments.
• You possess 1+ years of knowledge regarding GDPR, AI Act, or NIS2 frameworks.
• You're proactive and solution-oriented with strong analytical and communication skills.
• You have active knowledge of Dutch OR French (with good understanding of the other language), and English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience within the public sector or the G-Cloud environment.
• Ability to translate technical findings into actionable measures for non-technical stakeholders.

• Implement AI services, agents, retrieval solutions, and API integrations.
• Build reusable components for model access, prompting, context management, and logging.
• Establish automated test and evaluation sets for quality, security, performance, and cost management.
• Apply CI/CD and MLOps/LLMOps practices for version control, deployment, and monitoring.
• Provide technical support for sandboxes and proofs of concept to ensure production readiness.
• Collaborate with data and platform teams to ensure secure data flows and system integration.

Requirements

• You bring 5+ years of hands-on experience as a software, platform, or ML Engineer.
• You possess strong programming skills in Python and Java.
• You have practical knowledge of LLMs, embeddings, retrieval techniques, and AI agents.
• You have experience with APIs, authentication, containers, and automated testing.
• You possess expertise in CI/CD, Git, Infrastructure as Code, and observability.
• You're attentive to security, privacy, and operational reliability standards.
• You're proactive and solution-oriented with strong communication and advisory skills.
• You are active in Dutch and French with a passive knowledge of English.
Nice to Haves

• Knowledge of the public sector or G-Cloud context.
• Ability to provide a strategic vision on AI implementation in public services.
